manual_review_notes: Tomato sauce -> butter -> chocolate pudding into the basket:1/5 fully reviewed success. ParentCTR_088 remains0/5. Only pudding is shifted16.5cm toward negative worldX and1.5cm toward negativeY, matching an observed low empty-closing corridor in the failed parent. Earlier tomato, butter and basket poses are retained. This is a substantial source-pose repair, not a millimetre adjustment. The new experiment also predeclares the established stricter released/supported/settled terminal contract, so the comparison changes both source pose and terminal protocol and is not an isolated causal success-rate estimate. All five episodes use the existing RAIN checkpoints and unchanged1200-control cap; the one success completes at778. This is a reviewer variant with direct original40 skill lineage.

episode_reviews.notes: Reviewed all97 saved frames and the complete778-control trace. Tomato sauce is deliberately grasped, carried and released into the basket. Butter requires repeated empty closing attempts before the successful pickup, then is transported and released onto the tomato sauce inside the basket. The shifted chocolate pudding is deliberately grasped at its repaired source, transported and released, finally supported by tomato sauce and butter. The recorded physical observer confirms all three objects are free of every robot contact, retain their ordered native In goals, and have positive support paths through the exact basket base to the original floor for controls774-778, with linear speed <=0.02m/s and angular speed <=0.5rad/s. The butter also contacts a basket sidewall, but has a qualifying upward support path through tomato sauce to the base; sidewall contact alone does not qualify. Earlier tomato placement remains within0.44mm and0.58deg after control160; butter remains within2.65mm and5.87deg during the pudding stage starting604. This is ordinary settling and small final stacking contact, without knockover or loss of earlier results. No final TC condition, forced post-rollout opening, passive simulation or extra budget was used.

comparison_design_note: Pose repair plus a predeclared stricter terminal protocol; parent native outcomes remain frozen. Earlier failed source search and current1/5 are exploratory evidence, not a controlled generalization estimate.
